scenarios.name: Explain unfamiliar parser
scenarios.objective: Use /explain to understand legacy-ish code before editing anything.
prompts: Explain how this parser treats malformed rows and what tradeoffs it makes.
scenarios.verify: No file changes required. Confirm the explanation mentions blank lines, trimming, and malformed row handling.
scenarios.fallback: Highlight the reduce block and ask: /explain #selection

scenarios.name: Fix a targeted bug
scenarios.objective: Use /fix or a focused prompt to repair a known bug with minimal change.
prompts: /fix The discount helper is adding the wrong amount after rounding. Make the smallest change that makes the failing tests pass.
Read src/scenario_2_discount.js, find the root cause of the rounding bug, and suggest the smallest safe patch.
scenarios.verify: cd ide-chat && node --test tests/scenario_2_discount.test.js (create test file first or use cli/ tests as reference)
scenarios.fallback: Show the applyDiscount function and ask Chat to find the off-by-one.

scenarios.name: Generate tests for an untested utility
scenarios.objective: Use /tests to generate a first test suite for a utility with no tests.
prompts: Generate node:test coverage for empty input, trimming, optional highlights, and skipped invalid entries in ide_chat_releaseNotes.js.
scenarios.verify: Save the new file under ide-chat/tests/ and run: node --test ide-chat/tests/<new-file>.test.js
scenarios.fallback: Ask Copilot to propose test cases first, then ask it to turn them into node:test tests.

scenarios.name: Multi-file reasoning with @workspace
scenarios.objective: Use @workspace to trace behavior across scripts, source files, tests, and scenarios.
prompts: @workspace Where do setup, cleanup, and test verification commands live in this repo?
@workspace If I want to explain how pricing, validation, and parser behavior are covered here, which files should I show and why?
scenarios.verify: Answer should cite multiple files across cli/ and ide-chat/ (not just one).
scenarios.fallback: Use #file references for cli/scenarios.json, cli/src/scenario_2_discount.js, and ide-chat/src/ide_chat_releaseNotes.js, then ask the same question.

scenarios.name: Repository instructions walkthrough
scenarios.objective: Show how repo-level Copilot instructions shape Chat responses for this sandbox.
prompts: What repo-level Copilot instructions are active here, and how should they affect your edits?
Using the repository instructions, propose a safe plan for fixing the bug in ide-chat/src/scenario_2_discount.js without broad refactors.
scenarios.verify: Response should mention minimal edits, testing after changes, and avoiding unrelated churn.
scenarios.fallback: Open .github/copilot-instructions.md and ask Chat to summarize the top three rules it will follow.
